esp32.detail: 3 pins wired; AH3503 linear Hall sensor needs at least 4.5 V, so it is powered from 5 V. U2.OUT → D32 (GPIO32) — an analog-capable pin. Added a 10 kΩ / 20 kΩ divider on OUT: it swings to 5 V, and the D32 pin takes 3.3 V at most. Added the ah3503.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the magnetic field set on the slider: passes

pico.detail: 3 pins wired; AH3503 linear Hall sensor needs at least 4.5 V, so it is powered from 5 V. U2.OUT → GP28 (GPIO28) — an analog-capable pin. Added a 10 kΩ / 20 kΩ divider on OUT: it swings to 5 V, and the GP28 pin takes 3.3 V at most. Added the ah3503.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the magnetic field set on the slider: passes
